outcome: Agent Computer Use is the best watched Computer Use path: visible signed cursor, accurate independent readback, and snappy per-click speed are equal to round-trip and token efficiency versus Codex bundled Computer Use (Sky/node_repl) and raw cua-driver.
non_goals: Exposing all 54 cua-driver tools as the agent vocabulary
A parallel live suite beside pointer/parity/live-validator
pass_signals: One ready MCP server; no duplicate Computer Use catalogs
Default MCP tools/list is exactly start_session, state, act, verify, end_session
MCP start_session → one compact state → batched asserted act/plan → verify only when act.verified is false → immediate probe-app cleanup → end_session is the default agent loop
MCP lifecycle/state/act stay in one Python process; telemetry reports cli_invocations=0
Interleaved live Calculator A/B resets its fixture, omits separately graded pointer capture, passes every run, and persistent dispatch is at least 10% faster than per-call macos-cua.py
Raw bin/cua-driver-mcp and per-call macos-cua.py spawn are diagnostic/bench only
Live parity + pointer + elon empty-iteration stay green
Verified coordinate clicks on accessible text map the screen point through AXRangeForPosition and prove the resulting selection; no desktop-global click or recapture
AX-incomplete composers (WhatsApp/Catalyst) prove by screenshot or Voice→Send, not typed_path ok; native type-text with empty AX is ax_incomplete_value
Native AX snapshot walks an open AXSheet/AXPopover/AXDialog, else open app-level context menus then one window
Cursor plugin spawn is not {workspace}/bin/agent-computer-use-mcp; dest uses an absolute launcher with cwd ./; ~/.cursor/mcp.json does not advertise agent-computer-use unless --user-mcp
Official suite duration/max-step/bytes must not regress vs the last warm green; do not loosen budget_seconds

criteria.accuracy: Independent readback of the intended control or result; dispatch acceptance is not proof; no false-green type/click
criteria.visibility: Signed operator cursor glides to the target before AX; method agent-cursor-glide*; cursor_sync ok. Observe-only rows set pointer_required false
criteria.speed: Watched automation: total <= budget_seconds and each pointer step <= max_step_ms. A labeled click must not sit ~30s
criteria.efficiency: Asserted run for 3+ actions; fewer round-trips than N granular MCP calls
criteria.context_efficiency: No unfiltered state; --query/--diff; compact final.text; no chat dumps; parity run <12000 bytes
criteria.robustness: One owner path; All Clear|Clear; expect ignores acted control; role-scoped heading; AX 1.5s timeout; no silent pixel fallback

rating_model.accuracy: trust gate, not averaged into overall: 10.0 if readback passed every repeat else 0.0
rating_model.visibility: trust gate, not averaged into overall: 10.0 if visibility passed every repeat else 0.0; None when pointer_required is false
rating_model.speed: _floor_score(p50_duration, floor_seconds); when both floor_max_step_ms and measured p50 max step exist, average with _floor_score(p50_max_step, floor_max_step_ms)
rating_model.reliability: 10 * pass_rate; if p95_duration/p50_duration > 1.5 subtract 2.0; never below 0
rating_model.robustness: 10 * fraction of repeats with measured.robust true
rating_model.efficiency: _floor_score(p50_ax_snapshots, floor_ax_snapshots); None if floor_ax_snapshots is absent or null
rating_model.token_efficiency: _floor_score(p50_driver_calls, floor_driver_calls); None if floor_driver_calls is null
rating_model.floor_score: None if floor is null (unrated, not 0); 10.0 if p50<=0 (nothing spent); 0.0 if floor<=0 and p50>0; else 10 * clamp01(floor / p50)
rating_model.overall: unweighted mean of GRADED_KEYS (speed, reliability, robustness, efficiency, token_efficiency) that are not None; never count None as 0
rating_model.unrated: sorted GRADED_KEYS whose score is None
rating_model.gated: true when any trust gate (accuracy, visibility) is 0; trust_failures lists those rows
rating_model.budget_gate: budget_* is the fail-closed pass/fail gate in score_measured() and is never a rating denominator
rating_model.floor_bytes: len(json.dumps(minimal proof-bearing payload, separators=(',', ':')).encode()); calculator 52, folder 40, textedit 51, whatsapp 49. Bytes stay a budget gate, not a GRADED_KEYS axis
rating_model.floor_ax_snapshots: irreducible _native_ax_snapshot calls for the pass_signal: calculator 2 (button tree + independent AXStaticText 64), folder 1 (Downloads tree), textedit 3 (textarea, Copy menu, restore), whatsapp 2 (closed tree + AXHeading)
rating_model.floor_driver_calls: irreducible driver RPCs after native AX press: calculator 1 (cursor), folder 0 (observe-only), textedit 1 (glide), whatsapp 1 (glide). Do not count 5 calculator clicks as 5 driver calls

safety: No chat dumps. No personal identifiers. No new send/payment authority. Live gate uses Calculator/TextEdit/Finder. WhatsApp benchmark is query/compact observe only; require Message yourself then (You) before any send.
baseline: Thin 5-tool MCP vs Sky ~10 methods. With a clean Calculator fixture and pointer capture graded separately, persistent in-process dispatch measured 55.0%–71.8% faster than per-call CLI across successful interleaved Calculator state+act runs, with cli_invocations=0. The source-frozen gate measured 0.606s versus 1.348s p50. Live parity passed on cua-driver 0.20.0. Cursor plugin ./bin spawn is dest-absolute after install_harness cursor-plugin.
